{
  "dataset_name": "car_evaluation",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "l2_norm_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "L2 norm of all features after dividing each by its training-set standard deviation, giving a scale-normalized distance from the origin",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a single scalar summarizing overall feature magnitude in a scale-invariant way, improving neighborhood geometry for KNN",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt((buying/1.1598)**2 + (maint/1.0856)**2 + (doors/1.1063)**2 + (persons/0.8193)**2 + (lug_boot/0.8232)**2 + (safety/0.8057)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cost_composite_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of buying and maint scaled by their standard deviations, representing total cost burden normalized for distance computation",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures combined cost signal in a scale-normalized form that reduces distortion in KNN distance calculations",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(buying/1.1598) + (maint/1.0856)"
    },
    {
      "name": "utility_composite_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of persons, lug_boot, and safety scaled by their standard deviations, representing overall utility normalized for distance computation",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates utility-related features in scale-normalized form, improving KNN neighborhood separation between high and low utility cars",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(persons/0.8193) + (lug_boot/0.8232) + (safety/0.8057)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cost_utility_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of scaled cost composite to scaled utility composite plus a small epsilon, capturing cost-to-utility trade-off",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes the cost-utility trade-off as a single ratio feature that helps KNN distinguish value-for-money configurations",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((buying/1.1598) + (maint/1.0856)) / ((persons/0.8193) + (lug_boot/0.8232) + (safety/0.8057) + 0.1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dist_to_low_cost_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance from the row to an unsupervised low-cost prototype defined by minimum feature values (all zeros), scale-normalized",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures proximity to the cheapest/lowest-feature-value corner of the feature space, helping KNN identify extreme low-cost configurations",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt((buying/1.1598)**2 + (maint/1.0856)**2 + (doors/1.1063)**2 + (persons/0.8193)**2 + (lug_boot/0.8232)**2 + (safety/0.8057)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dist_to_high_value_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance from the row to an unsupervised high-value prototype defined by maximum feature values (buying=0, maint=0, doors=3, persons=2, lug_boot=2, safety=2), scale-normalized",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures proximity to the high-utility, low-cost corner of the feature space, helping KNN identify desirable car configurations",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((buying-0)/1.1598)**2 + ((maint-0)/1.0856)**2 + ((doors-3)/1.1063)**2 + ((persons-2)/0.8193)**2 + ((lug_boot-2)/0.8232)**2 + ((safety-2)/0.8057)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dist_to_mean_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance from the row to the training-set mean vector, scale-normalized using training standard deviations",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures how far a row is from the average car configuration, useful for KNN to identify outlier or typical configurations",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((buying-1.4754)/1.1598)**2 + ((maint-1.3971)/1.0856)**2 + ((doors-1.4899)/1.1063)**2 + ((persons-1.0348)/0.8193)**2 + ((lug_boot-0.9768)/0.8232)**2 + ((safety-0.9884)/0.8057)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "safety_persons_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of safety and persons features, capturing joint safety-capacity signal relevant to car desirability",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes the interaction between safety and passenger capacity, which jointly determine desirability and help KNN find similar configurations",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "safety * persons"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_cost_low_utility_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for rows where both buying and maint are above their means AND safety or persons is at minimum, flagging unfavorable configurations",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a cluster indicator for unfavorable car configurations, helping KNN group similar undesirable cars together",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((buying > 1.4754) & (maint > 1.3971) & ((safety == 0) | (persons == 0)), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "low_cost_high_utility_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for rows where both buying and maint are below their means AND safety and persons are above their means, flagging favorable configurations",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a cluster indicator for favorable car configurations, helping KNN group similar desirable cars together",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((buying < 1.4754) & (maint < 1.3971) & (safety > 0.9884) & (persons > 1.0348), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_quality_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall car quality combining cost efficiency (low buying+maint), capacity (high persons), safety level, and luggage space into a holistic score from 0 (worst) to 10 (best)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a human-interpretable quality score that compresses domain knowledge into a single dimension, improving KNN distance calculations by aligning feature space with perceived quality",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": false
    },
    {
      "name": "feature_entropy_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Variance-like spread of scaled features around their row mean, measuring how heterogeneous the feature profile is for a given car",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures within-row feature diversity; cars with uniform profiles cluster differently than those with mixed high/low features, improving KNN neighborhood geometry",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((buying/1.1598 - (buying/1.1598 + maint/1.0856 + doors/1.1063 + persons/0.8193 + lug_boot/0.8232 + safety/0.8057)/6.0)**2 + (maint/1.0856 - (buying/1.1598 + maint/1.0856 + doors/1.1063 + persons/0.8193 + lug_boot/0.8232 + safety/0.8057)/6.0)**2 + (safety/0.8057 - (buying/1.1598 + maint/1.0856 + doors/1.1063 + persons/0.8193 + lug_boot/0.8232 + safety/0.8057)/6.0)**2) / 3.0)"
    }
  ]
}
